You see an echo of Murcion.

    Notes

    Appears in the Bakragore bossfight, replacing one of the Elder Bloodjaws in the fight, when The Essence of Murcion is used to activate a stage of the Bakragore's Burden. When killed, it respawns as an Elder Bloodjaw.
